title: Two Years
description:
Two years since {name} met Daeun.

Looking at the calendar, she said, "It's been exactly two years since we first met."

Triangular kimbap, buy-one-get-one. Across the convenience store counter. That was two years ago.

A lot had changed since. Gangnam was still far, the bank balance was different, the weight of Seoul was the same — and this person was still here, beside him.

"...We're okay like this, right?" Daeun said the thing she seemed not to be asking.

choices.text: "We're okay. It means a lot, you being here." — evenly
choices.result_text:
Daeun looked at {name} for a long moment. "I know. I just like to check sometimes."

The words were plain. Proof that this thing hadn't started to shake yet.

choices.text: "Two whole years. I can't believe it either." — honest
choices.result_text:
Daeun laughed. "Same."

So this is how two years pass. Moving along in a way that's not bad at all.

choices.text: "Honestly — I'm struggling a lot lately." — first time admitting it
choices.result_text:
Daeun listened quietly. The ₩3B, the time.

"I know. I just... want to struggle with you."

That was oddly comforting.

title: Wedding Photo
description:
SNS notification.

A post from Daeun's friend. A wedding venue in Busan. Among the guests — Daeun. At the bride's table. In a wedding dress.

{name} stopped scrolling.

Daeun got married.

The person who handed over triangle kimbap from behind the convenience store counter. Now in a different life.

choices.text: Liked it. Genuinely glad for her.
choices.result_text:
Liked the photo. Closed the app.

Glad. Really. That thought came quickly this time. Two years have passed. Changed that much, at least.

choices.text: Closed the screen. Better not to see it.
choices.result_text:
Scrolled past. Next post was a crypto ad.

Life went on. {name} had to keep going too. Just — stopped for a moment.

title: She Got There First
description:
A message from Daeun.

"I got a job! A small company over in the Gangnam district."

{name} laughed for a second.

The one who'd be working in Gangnam was Daeun, not {name}. Four years of running — and she got there first.

That fact, strangely, didn't sit light.

choices.text: "That's great. When I get there, let's grab a cafe nearby." — happy for her
choices.result_text:
"It's a promise." Daeun said.

Said lightly, landed heavily. Gangnam becoming a promise instead of a goal. That came sooner than expected.

choices.text: (First thought: she's going to get there before me)
choices.result_text:
{name} said nothing. Daeun seemed to notice something.

Strange feeling. Said he'd take her there — and she's already going. Not bad, but — oddly complicated.

title: The Night Before ₩3B
description:
The number is almost there.

Daeun set out dinner. Rolled omelette — something {name} once said he liked.

An old friend. Someone who'd held on in the same city for five years.

"Something feels different today," Daeun said.

{name} didn't answer. Tomorrow he'd know.

Five years were in this dinner.

choices.text: "We got here together. Without you I'd have quit halfway." — said it for the first time
choices.result_text:
Daeun stopped, then said, "I didn't do anything."
{name} shook his head. "No. You're the reason I didn't give up."

The two of them stayed a long while. The omelette went cold.

choices.text: Ate without words. Tomorrow's soon enough.
choices.result_text:
The egg roll was warm. Daeun was quiet too.

Maybe it was nights like this that got him all the way here. A night that needed no words.

description_if_known.daeun_year4_close:
Numbers almost there.

Daeun had made dinner. Rolled omelette. Something {name} had once mentioned liking.

"Today feels different somehow." Daeun said.

{name} said nothing. Tomorrow would show it.

Thought of that promise from four years ago — the cafe in Gangnam, when you get there. Tomorrow, that promise could be kept.

Five years lived in this one evening.
description_if_known.daeun_romance_started:
The number is almost there.

Daeun set out dinner. Rolled omelette — something {name} once said he liked.

It had been a few months since the cafe, since 'let's go together.' These dinners had become theirs since then.

"Something feels different today," Daeun said.

{name} didn't answer. Tomorrow he'd know.

Five years were in this dinner.

title: Separate Arrivals
description:
Gangnam-daero.

If Daeun were here — what would she say? That thought comes out of nowhere.

The person who stood behind a convenience store counter five years ago. Somewhere out there doing fine now. Married — {name} knows that.

{name} looked up at the apartment.

choices.text: Each got there. Glad she's okay.
choices.result_text:
{name} didn't dwell on it long.

Everyone has their own destination. He went this way, she went that way. They don't have to overlap. Just — hope she's well.

choices.text: Thought about reaching out for a second, then didn't.
choices.result_text:
Didn't reach out.

Contacting her on the day you make it feels like bragging. Didn't feel right.

Just stood there alone.

title: Today's Seoul
description:
Daeun's been at the Gangnam company for two months.

"When are you getting to Gangnam? I've already scoped out a cafe nearby."

{name} smiled.

Four of five years gone. Still short of Gangnam. Daeun's already close.
Strangely — no urgency.

description_if_known.jiyeon_respectfully_distanced:
Daeun's been at the Gangnam company for two months.

"When are you getting to Gangnam? I've already scoped out a cafe nearby."

{name} paused.

Last month, Jiyeon had come to Seoul. {name} had said the hard thing — there's someone. Daeun doesn't know about that conversation.

But today, hearing Daeun say this — it felt like the right choice.

choices.text: "Of course. The moment I get there." — affirm the promise
choices.result_text: That promise still standing — it gave today a different warmth.

choices.text: "Let's talk about it then. It's still far away." — answer honestly
choices.result_text: An honest answer. Daeun nodded. As if willing to wait.
